EPIC COMPLETE — the universal verified primitive basis (Stages 1-6) is built end-to-end, each stage critic-clean, every corpus L3 in real Verus. workspace ZERO failures; thermite-verified self-verification core 26 verified, 0 errors.

STAGE 1 ADTs (#63/#65/#67 + fixes #64/#66/#68/#69): recursive struct/enum/Box/match -> L3. Bugs caught+fixed: match-arm-struct-lit parse, exhaustiveness bypass via lowercase variant (-> UpperCamelCase mandate), per-item ADT-decl weave (L0->L3), recursive-fold generality (Tree fold).
STAGE 2 recursion schemes (#70 + #71): fold/map/for_all over ADTs + the fold_bound prove-once induction multiplier. Bug: cert-identity collision (multi-spec-fn files).
STAGE 3 effect stdlib (#72): effect atoms as contracted seccomp-confined #[boundary] primitives; outcome-coverage emergent (no new code); read_doubled -> L3 to_boundary.
STAGE 4 bounded collections (#73 + #74): Vec<T> over vstd (no-OOB get, capacity-preserving push). Bug: Vec-return mutation-synthesis gap (#48-analog).
STAGE 5 composition (#75): contract composition + honest min-aggregation (no new code; the shipped #52/#15/#60 compose the basis).
STAGE 6 security/IFC (#76 + #77): Tainted/Secret/Authorized + #[sealed] clean types -> SQLi/secret-leak/missing-authz UN-TYPEABLE. CRITICAL bug: the StructLit door-bypass made the guarantee hollow -> fixed via the #[sealed] abstraction barrier (a sealed type's only producer is its #[boundary] door; re-audit confirmed COMPLETE, 16 probes, no surviving launder).

v1.1 deferred: full dataflow taint-propagation (REQ-4), Map, Vec element-invariants, scheme fusion, the runnable foreign-syscall link. All design docs under .design/basis/. The loop caught 7 real divergences (incl. the door-bypass); all fixed + re-verified.
